notes: The italics on *Thou art* corroborate the supply but do not decide it (rule 7): no pronominal morpheme stands in the verbless clause, so *Thou* is `added`, while the copula joins the written predicate מִבְטָח (rule 20).
*fine gold* heads on *gold*, the class noun the ASV writes alone for זָהָב in this same verse, with *fine* read as its specifier (rule 31's tie sentence).
